rules.prepare:
#cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" #autoreconf -vfi || true
#cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/extension" #autoreconf -vfi || true
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" AWK=awk \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-nls
touch -d "2000-01-01" \ doc/gawktexi.in doc/gawk.texi doc/gawkinet.texi \ doc/gawk.info doc/gawkinet.info doc/sidebar.awk \ doc/gawkworkflow.texi doc/gawkworkflow.info
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/awk" rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/gawk-"*
